The image tests use real reference photographs from Pillow's upstream test suite:

- `hopper.jpg`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python-pillow/Pillow/12.3.0/Tests/images/hopper.jpg
- `flower.jpg`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python-pillow/Pillow/12.3.0/Tests/images/flower.jpg

Pillow's license: https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/12.3.0/LICENSE

These are image-comparison inputs, not Instagram response fixtures. Provider behavior
must be checked against the connected account with the live commands in the main README.
